requirement: The system shall provide an accessible emergency-stop function whose actuation initiates a defined safe stopping response.
The safety-related control system shall initiate a protective stop upon violation of the validated protective field.
The safety-related control system shall enforce validated speed limits appropriate to configuration and operating mode.
The safety-related control system shall prevent motion beyond validated joint and workspace limits.
The mechanical and control design shall prevent uncontrolled descent or load release on loss of power within the validated load envelope.
The system shall prevent operation outside the validated stability envelope for lift height arm posture and payload.
The system shall detect stale or lost motion commands and transition to the defined safe response within a validated time.
The system shall require deliberate operator action to restart after a latched protective or emergency stop.
Electrical power distribution shall include protection and isolation provisions based on electrical hazard assessment.
The system shall support controlled isolation and verification of hazardous energy before service.
